fields.description: u16 LE byte-sum checksum of save block 0 (stored with block bytes zeroed during summation).
fields.evidence: FUN_08021af8 zeroes SRAM 0x0E000000+0..2 via FUN_08021bfc, sums SRAM 0x0E000000+0..0x2000 via FUN_08021d20 (byte loop FUN_08001d60, result masked to 16 bits), and stores the u16 LE total at save offset 0x00 via FUN_0802e814; FUN_08021b58 re-sums the block and compares it against this stored halfword.
fields.name: header_checksum

fields.description: First 7 bytes of the 16-byte save ID block ('UKICANI'); the leading 'Z' of 'ZUKICANI' coincides with the checksum high byte and is not part of the compared region.
fields.evidence: Bytes save+0x02..0x09 sit inside the 16-byte ID block at save+0x02 that FUN_08021b58 compares against ROM constants via FUN_08001da8(DAT_08021ba8, buf, 0x10); the block travels with the 0x20-byte header copied by FUN_080219b0 and FUN_08021a24.
fields.name: save_title_tag

fields.description: Game code tail of the save ID block ('ACLJ'), last 4 bytes of the compared 16-byte region.
fields.evidence: Bytes save+0x0E..0x12 hold 'ACLJ' at the tail of the 16-byte ID block verified by FUN_08021b58 via FUN_08001da8(DAT_08021ba8, buf, 0x10); header block copied by FUN_080219b0 and FUN_08021a24.
fields.name: game_code_tag

fields.description: First u32 word of the 0x1FE0-byte save payload at save+0x20. Zero in the baseline (fresh save); exact gameplay meaning unidentified.
fields.evidence: Word lies at the head of the 0x1FE0-byte payload block-copied between SRAM and work RAM by FUN_080219b0 and FUN_08021a24 via FUN_08021cac(..., 0x1fe0), and is covered by the FUN_08021d20 byte-sum checksum over save+0x00..0x2000.
fields.name: payload_word_0

fields.description: Second u32 word of the 0x1FE0-byte save payload at save+0x20. Zero in the baseline (fresh save); exact gameplay meaning unidentified.
fields.evidence: Word lies in the 0x1FE0-byte payload block-copied between SRAM and work RAM by FUN_080219b0 and FUN_08021a24 via FUN_08021cac(..., 0x1fe0), and is covered by the FUN_08021d20 byte-sum checksum over save+0x00..0x2000.
fields.name: payload_word_1

fields.description: 16-bit flag halfword in the save payload. Zero in the baseline (fresh save); exact per-bit meaning unidentified.
fields.evidence: Halfword lies in the 0x1FE0-byte payload block-copied between SRAM and work RAM by FUN_080219b0 and FUN_08021a24 via FUN_08021cac(..., 0x1fe0), and is covered by the FUN_08021d20 byte-sum checksum over save+0x00..0x2000.
fields.name: payload_flags_0

magic_signatures.description: 16-byte save ID block at save+0x02 ('UKICANI' + padding + 'ACLJ') verified against ROM by FUN_08021b58.
